Definition: to be master; hence, to marry
BiblicalUsage: Ba'al as a verb means to be master, to marry — to take a wife and rule a house. God says to backsliding Israel, thy Maker is thine husband, and I will take you, one of a city and two of a family, and bring you to Zion. Malachi says Judah has married the daughter of a strange god, and profaned the holiness of the Lord. The word is marriage itself, in its right and its wrong.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God calls himself Israel's husband on purpose: marriage is the picture of the covenant, and breaking it is not a small sin. He is the Maker who married his people, and he will not share them with a strange god.
